title: Admit exact local Fore in constrained native output assignments
body:
The ordinary display-output Plot has exact typed frame/refusal Fore ports. Constrained assignment currently supports local cords and separately admitted network Line endpoints; it cannot encode a local external Fore without falsely inventing a Line. This blocks installing the already checked output graph on the ESP32.

Preserve that distinction with an explicitly opted-in native Fore projection. Keep the existing 125-byte envelope and schemas 4–6 unchanged. A new schema may use schema-specific local Fore records under endpoint tag 10, pinned to an independently checked resident ABI; those records contain no Line, peer, membership or authority. Legacy entry points must refuse the new schema. Validate the complete current Host/Boot envelope, finite counts, unique exact resident Fore records and computation inventory without allocation. Fore metadata never grants permission to submit values or perform effects.

Then extend the trusted Make producer and constrained table preparation to carry the exact boundary ordinals/directions/cords while retaining the typed value contract independently. Verify a real checked display graph through projection, ordinary kernel, actual Host Calls, cancellation and physical output. Keep old schema/remote endpoint tests passing. MCU installation, continuing sensor/Mask integration, recorder and overnight proof remain their own acceptance work; this issue must not be closed on a decoder-only test.

Hold preparation locally while the two current environment delivery PRs own the review slots. No Root memory guard changes, fake network bindings or second execution kernel.
